attackers_goals: Evade detection when running suspicious commands.
description: The process dllhost.exe was executed with an empty command line. This behavior is suspicious, and may be caused by a malicious actor using 'Image File Execution Options' in the registry to evade detection.
investigative_actions: Check if an entry for dllhost.exe was added in the registry, under HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options.
name: Execution of dllhost.exe with an empty command line

variations.name: Execution of unsigned dllhost from a non-typical path with empty command line
variations.description: An unsigned process was executed with the name dllhost.exe from a non-typical path, this behavior is suspicious and maybe performed by a malicious actor in an attempt to hide their actions.
variations.attackers_goals: Evade detection when performing suspicious actions.
variations.investigative_actions: Review actions performed by the executed process and the causality owner, and check if they are suspicious.
